summary.text: Tina McKinnor is a Democratic member of the California State Assembly from District 61 who took office on December 5, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Before the Assembly she worked as an auditor, a chief of staff in the Assembly and an operations director for the California Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Tina McKinnor was born in Los Angeles County, California.
She earned an A.A. in business administration and accounting from Los Angeles Southwest College in 2003 and a B.A. in accounting from California State University at Dominguez Hills in 2006.

Her career experience includes working as an auditor for the Los Angeles County Office of Education, a political treasurer for the Kaufman Legal Group, chief of staff for the California State Assembly, director of operations for the California Democratic Party, and civic engagement director of LAVoice.
McKinnor was re-elected on November 5, 2024, defeating Republican Al Hernandez, 76.5 percent to 23.5 percent.
In the June 2, 2026 primary she advanced to the general election alongside write-in candidate Brian Lockwood, a Republican.

For 2025 and 2026 she chaired the Public Employment and Retirement Committee and was a member of the Arts, Entertainment, Sports, and Tourism; Environmental Safety and Toxic Materials; Governmental Organization; Privacy and Consumer Protection; and Revenue and Taxation committees.
